title: Resolving FRET signal degeneracy and population heterogeneity via Bayesian nonparametrics

model_io.model: BNP-FRET-Bin (Bayesian nonparametric hidden Markov model)

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; framework learns state number automatically from data
